message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run regression tests in TeX Live

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  build-ubuntu:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - name: Install TeX Live
      uses: TeX-Live/setup-texlive-action@v4
      with:
        package-file: .github/workflows/texlive-package.txt
        packages: ppmcheckpdf
        update-all-packages: true
    - name: Test tabularray with l3build
      run: |
        l3build check --debug --halt-on-error --show-log-on-error
    - name: Install pdftoppm
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install poppler-utils
    - name: Test tabularray with ppmcheckpdf
      run: |
        ppmcheckpdf check
  build-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - name: Install TeX Live
      uses: TeX-Live/setup-texlive-action@v4
      with:
        package-file: .github/workflows/texlive-package.txt
        packages: ppmcheckpdf
        update-all-packages: true
    - name: Test tabularray with l3build
      run: |
        l3build check --debug --halt-on-error --show-log-on-error
    - name: Install pdftoppm
      run: |
        tlmgr install wintools.windows
    - name: Test tabularray with ppmcheckpdf
      run: |
        ppmcheckpdf check
    - name: Upload png and md5
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: png-and-md5
        path: |
          testfiles/*.png
          testfiles/*.md5
",
  "rationale": "Add a custom timeout to each job to prevent runaway CI runs. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern and its experiment examples (measured_ci_workflow_on_fork) show that bounding jobs with an explicit timeout reduces elapsed time (26.8% and 9.8% savings in the examples) and VM time (reported 12.9% free, 8.1% paid). Historical successful runs in this repository complete in ~7-8 minutes, so a 15-minute timeout provides operational headroom while still catching hung jobs. This change preserves all build and test steps and does not alter coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
